ISRG.headline: IEEE Designates First Robotic Telepresence Surgery System as an IEEE Milestone
ISRG.summary: The IEEE has officially recognized the "First Robotic Telepresence Surgery System," the technology licensed to Intuitive Surgical that became the da Vinci Surgical System, as an IEEE Milestone.

ISRG.headline: HSBC Adjusts Price Target on Intuitive Surgical to $392 From $391
ISRG.summary: HSBC has updated its price target for Intuitive Surgical, Inc., raising it slightly from $391 to $392.

ISRG.headline: Intuitive Surgical Executive Fredrik Widman Executes Stock Options and Sells Shares
ISRG.summary: Fredrik Widman, Corporate Vice President and Financial Controller at Intuitive Surgical, exercised stock options and sold 5,448 shares of company stock.

ISRG.headline: Intuitive Surgical Appoints Aaron Martin to Board of Directors
ISRG.summary: Intuitive Surgical has announced the appointment of Humana executive Aaron Martin to its board of directors, effective January 1, 2027.
